easyPrerequisites: You have a way to draw a card.
description:
Draw a card.
Lyla triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding one mana of any color.
When the Servo dies, Weatherlight Compleated triggers, putting a phyresis counter on it and causing you to draw a card.
Repeat from step 2.

uses.name: Weatherlight Compleated
uses.cardState: with six or more phyresis counters on it
